# DiagraMine — pinned to versions verified during the May 2026 sprint.

# Core CV / numerical
numpy>=1.24
opencv-python>=4.10
opencv-contrib-python>=4.10
Pillow>=10.0
matplotlib>=3.7
networkx>=3.0

# OCR backends (Phase 2a). PaddleOCR is the default text detector.
# Python 3.8–3.12 only: paddlepaddle 2.6 has no wheels for 3.13+.
paddleocr>=2.10,<3       # src/text_detection/paddle_detector.py uses the 2.x API
paddlepaddle>=2.6,<3     # the engine paddleocr runs on; not pulled in by paddleocr
# paddlepaddle 2.6 ships protobuf code generated for protobuf 3.x; with 4+ it
# fails at import ("Descriptors cannot be created directly"), and its Windows
# wheel pins <=3.20.2. This caps streamlit below 1.61 (see below).
protobuf>=3.20,<=3.20.2
easyocr>=1.7.2
pytesseract>=0.3.13
# NOTE: pytesseract needs the native tesseract binary, installed separately
# (UB-Mannheim installer on Windows, apt install tesseract-ocr, brew install
# tesseract). Tesseract is optional and not a default detector.

# Vision foundation model (Phase 2a, YOLOv8 zero-shot baseline)
ultralytics>=8.3
# Auto-downloads yolov8n.pt (~6 MB) into the repo root on first use.

# API serving + typed schemas (Phase 3, Day 4)
fastapi>=0.115
uvicorn>=0.34
python-multipart>=0.0.22
pydantic>=2.5

# Evaluation
rapidfuzz>=3.14

# Day-7 production wrapper
streamlit>=1.40,<1.61   # 1.40+ for st.image(use_container_width=...); 1.61+ needs
                        # protobuf>=5.26.1, incompatible with the protobuf pin above
httpx>=0.27         # FastAPI TestClient dep — used by tests/test_api.py
anthropic>=0.40     # benchmark_claude_vision.py — vision API harness
